subject: South Medford Connector Section 106 Review
overview: The commission appointed a new liaison to the Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust and discussed the South Medford Connector community path project. Members also reviewed zoning incentives for historic preservation and received progress reports on ongoing archaeological and cemetery surveys.

items.title: Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust Appointment
items.summary: The commission appointed former commissioner Ben Johnson as the official liaison to the Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust.

items.title: South Medford Connector Section 106 Review
items.summary: Commissioners and members of the public discussed the proposed community path between the General Lawrence Bridge and Winthrop Street, focusing on the desire for passive recreation and river access.

items.title: Zoning Update
items.summary: The commission reviewed the status of Boston Avenue zoning reform and the development of incentives for preserving significant historic structures.

items.title: Hegner Center Demolition
items.summary: The commission noted the city's intent to demolish the facility and heard public comment regarding the site's condition and federal funding.

items.title: Project Updates and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The commission reviewed ongoing archaeological surveys at the Brooks Estate, cemetery radar projects, and approved the June 2026 meeting minutes.
